description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotion categories within the IEMOCAP dataset, representing the original proportions of different emotional states present in the data. The chart contains six slices, each corresponding to a specific emotion. These include Neutral, colored blue and representing approximately 23.1% of the data; Happiness, colored purple and representing 8.1%; Excitement, colored red and representing 14.1%; Sadness, colored orange and representing 14.7%; Anger, colored yellow and representing 14.9%; and Frustration, colored light blue and representing 25.1%. Percentage values are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, roughly descending in proportion from Frustration to Happiness. A legend is not present, as the slice labels are displayed directly next to their corresponding segments.
